channel.title: Acme: W3C Changes
channel.description: Reports on substantive changes in W3C GitHub repositories.

item.title: CSS Color 4 Refines Ray-Trace Gamut Mapping
item.description:
The CSS Color 4 draft revises its sample ray-tracing gamut-mapping algorithm for numerical edge cases. It clamps the achromatic anchor to the destination gamut and adjusts intersection calculations and tolerances, reducing rounding problems near the gamut boundary.

Changes: csswg-drafts 1cf991828d; csswg-drafts de8437bf9c; csswg-drafts 16d99fc592.

item.title: RDF Test Vocabulary Adds Syntax Format Property
item.description:
The RDF test vocabulary adds rdft:syntaxFormat to test subclasses, giving manifests a way to identify the syntax format under test. The associated manifest cleanup removes cross-version includes that could blur RDF 1.1 and 1.2 coverage.

Changes: rdf-tests 9fafbec5e6; rdf-tests 80b800352c.

item.title: Recognized Entities Draft Adds Registration Property
item.description:
The Verifiable Credentials Recognized Entities draft adds a registration property to describe how an entity is recorded in an issuer-maintained register, such as a business or accreditation register. Its UNTP example is updated to demonstrate the field.

Changes: vc-recognized-entities b6ecd6743c.

item.title: Recognized Entities Draft Tightens Retrieval Security and Time Limits
item.description:
The Recognized Entities draft adds guidance against server-side request forgery from unverified URLs and uses maxDuration and depth limits to bound retrieval chains. It also clarifies evaluation time and digestMultibase protection for externally referenced resources. These are draft security and verification rules.

Changes: vc-recognized-entities 13ff1d7ec0; vc-recognized-entities 36c632971a; vc-recognized-entities eb77f29f47; vc-recognized-entities 416d23e052; vc-recognized-entities a49cd97972.

item.title: SHACL Rules Draft Adds Grouping and Aggregation Example
item.description:
The SHACL Rules work adds an example illustrating grouping and aggregation and explains when those rules run relative to rules that produce their input data. The example helps distinguish aggregate rule evaluation from ordinary rule execution.

Changes: data-shapes 218d5803cf.

item.title: Encrypted Media Explainer Revises Embedded-Key Rotation Proposal
item.description:
An Encrypted Media explainer now proposes using the existing MediaKeySession.update() method for embedded keys instead of adding session-management APIs. This remains a proposal in an explainer, not a newly standardized EME behavior.

Changes: encrypted-media 7a5533c256.

item.title: DID Resolution Revises Results and HTTP Status Mapping
item.description:
The DID Resolution draft removes a separate DID URL Dereferencing Result section, requires defining specifications to provide URLs for error types, and specifies HTTP status behavior for complete and successful results. These changes sharpen interoperable resolution responses.

Changes: did-resolution 60ba893916; did-resolution c3febac372; did-resolution 1c9ceb1cf6.

item.title: Draft Agentic Web Charter Expands Identity and Threat-Model Scope
item.description:
The draft Agentic Web Working Group charter now covers two-way identity flows, delegation and interaction modes, measurement, and a privacy/security threat-model Note. The text discusses prompt injection, exfiltration, tracking and misleading outputs. These are proposed charter deliverables, not adopted standards.

Changes: charter-drafts a943ce5300; charter-drafts 019c05a0a9; charter-drafts c22e34d82b; charter-drafts 24c5314a1b.

item.title: Core Accessibility Mapping Adds Computed Properties
item.description:
Core-AAM adds a Computed Accessibility Properties section describing platform-independent string key/value representations of accessible-object states and properties. This is specification work intended to clarify accessibility-tree exposure across platforms.

Changes: aria 3bee34f667.

item.title: OWL-Time Refines Interval Relationships
item.description:
OWL-Time edits add timePertainsTo as the inverse of hasTime, explain elementary interval relations, and revisit disjointness axioms after some proved inconsistent with OWL-DL requirements. The ontology changes affect temporal-data modeling rather than a browser API.

Changes: sdw-time 0ce7630471; sdw-time e123b11d8c; sdw-time 8f94e21330; sdw-time c1455ab9d5; sdw-time 19b2bbdfc3.

item.title: Attribution Reporting Expands Privacy-Budget Explanation
item.description:
The Attribution Reporting draft expands its explanation of configured privacy budgets as controls on differentially private information released by impression-store queries. The change clarifies a privacy safeguard in the developing API.

Changes: attribution 69e8cb75b6.

item.title: Window Management Limits Display-State Media Features in Frames
item.description:
The Window Management draft restricts display-state and resizable media features to top-level browsing contexts; child frames do not expose the parent window’s actual state through these features. This narrows the proposed feature’s scope.

Changes: window-management 2163d952e2.

item.title: W3C Internationalization Assistant Improves Source Retrieval
item.description:
The ask-i18n tool gains string-meta source support, GitHub Pages citations for draft and review documents, and revised query understanding and retrieval scoring. It also handles multiline quoted environment settings. These changes affect the assistant’s source indexing and citations, not W3C internationalization guidance itself.

Changes: ask-i18n 3195d4d628; ask-i18n 2e5f264836; ask-i18n c794216af1; ask-i18n 1b35cabdb7.

item.title: IndexedDB Clarifies Record Identity and Shared Buffers
item.description:
The IndexedDB draft says object-valued IDBRecord key getters return the same object instance on repeated reads. It also explicitly rejects a SharedArrayBuffer-backed value as a database key, aligning key conversion with its type constraints.

Changes: IndexedDB 3e0add12cb; IndexedDB 0667ebafda.

item.title: ActivityPub Normalizes Public Audience References
item.description:
ActivityPub examples and references now use the ActivityStreams as:Public identifier consistently. The edit reduces ambiguity about the special public audience value in federation examples.

Changes: activitypub 5d9b94414f.

item.title: Incremental Font Transfer Encoder Adds Brotli Arena Allocation
item.description:
The IFT encoder adds a Brotli arena allocator, changing its memory-allocation path for compression work. This is an implementation change to the encoder, not a modification of the Incremental Font Transfer specification.

Changes: ift-encoder d734ca2391.

item.title: WoT Scripting Defines Payload Parsing Failure Behavior
item.description:
The Web of Things Scripting API draft introduces InteractionOutputError as a DOMException and specifies rejection when parsing an interaction payload throws. The changes give applications a clearer error path for malformed or unexpected interaction responses.

Changes: wot-scripting-api 62319da947; wot-scripting-api 07820d15e4.

item.title: Encrypted Media Clarifies Key Replacement Algorithm
item.description:
The Encrypted Media draft defines key replacement as CDM management of keys within a session when new keys arrive, including possible eviction. The wording clarifies the model for key rotation and replaces imprecise requirement language.

Changes: encrypted-media 419fb4401c.

item.title: ODRL Draft Expands AI Usage Vocabulary
item.description:
The ODRL work updates draft vocabulary and examples for AI-related uses, including training, generative-AI training and general AI usage. These are rights-expression terms under development, not legal permissions granted by the vocabulary itself.

Changes: odrl 83edb765fb; odrl d8bf24bbc4.

item.title: SVG Draft Resolves Rendering and DOM Edge Cases
item.description:
SVG 2 clarifies several behaviors: a boundary path-length query returns the earlier segment; image documents can synthesize a viewBox from dimensions; SVGLength preserves its unit when value is set; textPath relayout follows referenced-shape changes; one CSS px equals one user unit; and invalid reflected values fall back to initial values without throwing.

Changes: svgwg c76199185d; svgwg 0206c206dc; svgwg 0a07be36fd; svgwg 750343a132; svgwg b092f450f8; svgwg 2bda4146e7.

item.title: CSS Counter Styles Adds N’Ko Ordinals and Simplifies Names
item.description:
The Counter Styles draft adds an N’Ko ordinal style. It also makes shorter Japanese and Korean style names canonical while preserving former formal and informal names as aliases, limiting compatibility disruption.

Changes: csswg-drafts 674d876257; csswg-drafts 10ae270718.

item.title: CSS Moves Intrinsic-Size Interpolation into Sizing 4
item.description:
The CSS Working Group moved calc-size() and interpolate-size material from Values 5 into Sizing 4. This is a specification-organization change, not a newly implemented browser feature; it places the sizing-specific definitions together.

Changes: csswg-drafts ee30871a66.

item.title: SHACL UI Defines Built-In Property Roles Without Mandating Them
item.description:
SHACL UI vocabulary updates add built-in property roles such as depiction roles while removing language that would have required implementations to support every property role. The draft thus gains concrete role definitions without imposing a blanket implementation mandate.

Changes: data-shapes 1a341d83a4; data-shapes 9710a6283d.

item.title: EPUB Draft Refines Data URL and Media-Type Language
item.description:
EPUB specification edits clarify where data URLs cannot create top-level browsing contexts and refine the definition of a core media type’s MIME media type. The changes tighten publication-resource terminology and constraints.

Changes: epub-specs 531bc94c70; epub-specs 46ec8ae444.

item.title: WebExtensions Draft Documents Common API Conventions
item.description:
The WebExtensions Community Group merged guidance on shared API conventions, including method names and constant casing. It is convention-setting documentation for future API design, not a newly shipped extension capability.

Changes: webextensions 8def346ce2.

item.title: WoT S7 Binding Clarifies Controller Addresses
item.description:
The Web of Things S7 binding draft clarifies controller host addressing and S7 memory-area syntax, including a restriction against IPv6 addresses for S7 controllers. The changes make industrial-device bindings more precise.

Changes: wot-binding-templates 44c8be6539.

item.title: CSS Color Clarifies Powerless Hue Handling
item.description:
CSS Color 4 clarifies that chroma is set to zero when a powerless hue becomes missing, and adds sample JavaScript for the conversion. The update makes the intended color-conversion behavior easier for implementers to reproduce.

Changes: csswg-drafts 1da0d9fb61; csswg-drafts 81ee91c4c8.

item.title: CSS Draft Adds Script Access to Container Query Matches
item.description:
A CSS Conditional 5 draft introduces matchContainer() and ContainerQueryList so script can evaluate container-query conditions. The proposal remains draft specification work; the commit does not establish browser support.

Changes: csswg-drafts e405e564cc.

item.title: DID Threat Model Expands to Resolution Services
item.description:
The DID threat-model draft now covers DID Resolution service providers in its architecture and threat components, including risks from the data those providers observe. It is a developing threat analysis, not a final DID protocol change.

Changes: did-threat-model c818f4fee8; did-threat-model ddaa43fc73.

item.title: SOSA/SSN Aligns More Terms Under the SOSA Namespace
item.description:
The SOSA/SSN vocabulary work moves additional sensing, sampling and actuation terms into the SOSA namespace. The change affects how ontology users refer to these properties and classes in RDF data.

Changes: sdw-sosa-ssn c629fa7748.

item.title: WebCodecs Rejects Zero Video Encoder Bitrate
item.description:
The WebCodecs draft now says VideoEncoderConfig with bitrate zero fails configuration support checking. The explicit rule removes an edge-case ambiguity for applications and encoder implementations.

Changes: webcodecs 2b849bb515.

item.title: WebExtensions Draft Describes the Alarms API in IDL
item.description:
The WebExtensions specification now includes an IDL description of the Alarms API for scheduling one-time or repeating alarms. The draft documents a common extension capability and its interface shape.

Changes: webextensions 37327e8dde.

item.title: CSS Text Clarifies East Asian Spacing Controls
item.description:
CSS Text 4 restores the full value space for text-spacing-trim and clarifies how insert and replace interact with text-autospace defaults. These draft changes refine controls for spacing around fullwidth and other East Asian text.

Changes: csswg-drafts 6dbb905c3f; csswg-drafts 06088e7d63.

item.title: Performance Timeline Corrects Dropped-Entry Counting
item.description:
Performance Timeline now counts a dropped performance entry only when the entry should have been buffered. This avoids treating entries excluded before buffer insertion as losses caused by a full buffer.

Changes: performance-timeline 9dadc5e8da.

item.title: Web App Manifest Reflects Application Display Context
item.description:
The Web App Manifest draft adds language requiring the display-mode media feature to reflect an application context through its application value. This distinguishes app-window context from other display modes for CSS evaluation.

Changes: manifest d943bfe5e4.

item.title: WebAuthn Explainer Proposes Embedded Credential Requests
item.description:
A new WebAuthn explainer describes embedded credential requests for authentication within an embedded context. It is an exploratory proposal, not a change to the WebAuthn Recommendation or an assertion of interoperable browser support.

Changes: webauthn 69b8b460cc.

item.title: Draft Audio Charter Separates Speech Recognition and Synthesis
item.description:
The draft Audio Working Group charter separates Web Speech Recognition and Web Speech Synthesis into distinct prospective deliverables. This follows a group resolution but remains charter language, not a claim that either specification is complete.

Changes: charter-drafts 9dfddd5a59.

item.title: CSS Color Defines Missing Channels in Math Expressions
item.description:
CSS Color 5 clarifies that channel keywords whose value is none can appear in math expressions. The change resolves a specification ambiguity in relative color calculations rather than announcing a new implementation.

Changes: csswg-drafts 7d677b2f04.

item.title: Permissions Policy Explainer Proposes Focus Without Activation
item.description:
The Permissions Policy repository gained an explainer and security/privacy questionnaire for a proposed focus-without-user-activation feature. These documents explore allowing focus in constrained contexts; they are not a finalized policy directive.

Changes: webappsec-permissions-policy 81e7009cd7; webappsec-permissions-policy f21b77954f.

item.title: Permissions Policy Clarifies Header Parsing
item.description:
The Permissions Policy draft now gives the first duplicate feature entry precedence, skips malformed source URLs with blob schemes or credentials, and states parsing rules in prose. Together these changes narrow inconsistent interpretations of policy headers.

Changes: webappsec-permissions-policy 960c4e429e; webappsec-permissions-policy c25886f557; webappsec-permissions-policy 901eabae76.

item.title: CSS Color Corrects Jzazbz Inverse Conversion Examples
item.description:
Two CSS Color changes correct the inverse PQ exponent and matrix multiplication order in sample Jzazbz conversion code. They matter to implementers copying the reference conversion examples; they do not redefine the color space.

Changes: csswg-drafts d6ef4eb827; csswg-drafts ba82c73b56.

item.title: Draft Audio Working Group Charter Adds Web MIDI 2.0
item.description:
The draft Audio Working Group charter now lists Web MIDI 2.0 as a potential Recommendation-track deliverable alongside the Web Speech API.

Adoption would depend on specification maturity, support from multiple implementers, and group consensus. The addition is a charter proposal, not a commitment to standardize Web MIDI 2.0.

Changes: charter-drafts commit 26378675.

item.title: SHACL Shapes Graphs Can Suggest Their Data Graphs
item.description:
SHACL 1.2 Core now defines sh:dataGraph, allowing a shapes graph to identify one or more data graphs it is intended to validate. Each value must be an IRI.

A processor may use the hint when the caller has not supplied a data graph explicitly. Unlike sh:shapesGraph, owl:imports in a referenced data graph are not followed.

Changes: data-shapes commit a6ed26f7.

item.title: Chinese Layout Requirements Adds Segmentation and Selection Guidance
item.description:
Requirements for Chinese Text Layout now explains why grapheme, word, and selection boundaries in Chinese cannot always be inferred from spaces. A new example shows how the same character sequence can admit different word segmentations.

The guidance discusses dictionary use, linguistic context, mixed-script text, cursor movement, and selection behavior so editing systems do not impose assumptions derived from space-delimited languages.

Changes: clreq commit 08a701fa.

item.title: MathML Schema Work Begins Aligning with MathML 4
item.description:
The MathML schema repository has begun a MathML 4 XSD based on the MathML 3 schema, with updated semantics content, token elements, links, attributes, and length-percentage values.

Related MathML 3 validation now processes foreign attributes laxly rather than skipping them entirely. The MathML 4 schema remains work in progress.

Changes: mathml-schema commit 9439b477; mathml-schema commit f934f55a; mathml-schema commit 97c0c5b5.

item.title: W3C Process No Longer Requires Advisory Committee Meetings In Person
item.description:
The W3C Process has removed the requirement that its twice-yearly Advisory Committee meetings be face-to-face.

The Team must still organize the meetings and appoint their chair, but the Process now permits remote or hybrid formats without treating them as exceptions.

Changes: process commit 1e355016.

item.title: Draft WoT EtherNet/IP Binding Adds Multidimensional Arrays
item.description:
The draft Web of Things EtherNet/IP binding now describes one- to three-dimensional array fields and the byte size of structured values.

Its JSON Schema rejects unsupported combinations such as arrays of BOOL or STRING and requires structured arrays to declare their element size, giving Thing Descriptions clearer validation.

Changes: wot-binding-templates commit 911be4b7.

item.title: OWL-Time Adds a BFO and Common Core Ontologies Alignment
item.description:
OWL-Time now includes an alignment module for Basic Formal Ontology and Common Core Ontologies.

The document maps temporal entities and relations into those upper ontologies, while the alignment axioms move into a separate RDF file so applications can adopt them without changing the core OWL-Time vocabulary.

Changes: sdw-time commit 497ead79.

item.title: DID Resolution Replaces Dereferencing with a Provisional Algorithm
item.description:
The DID Resolution draft has replaced its former at-risk dereferencing algorithm with a shorter provisional design and removed DID URL dereferencing from the HTTP(S) binding.

It also moves contentType into DID resolution metadata, where that field is defined, rather than DID document metadata. The dereferencing design remains provisional.

Changes: did-resolution commit a43a6588; did-resolution commit 61b8e5e8; did-resolution commit 8e096db9.

item.title: YAML-LD Defines Empty and Multi-Document Stream Behavior
item.description:
YAML-LD now defines how streams of zero or more YAML documents expand and convert to RDF, including empty, comments-only, whitespace-only, and null-root documents.

Null documents contribute no expanded nodes, while blank-node identity can remain shared across documents in one stream. New conformance cases cover mixed empty documents, rejected scalar roots, and reverse conversion.

Changes: yaml-ld commit 82fe1d97; yaml-ld commit 49da7ada; yaml-ld commit 4f586e24; yaml-ld commit 9de11b93; yaml-ld commit fafcf7ae.

item.title: RDF Schema Formalizes Vocabulary Registry Governance
item.description:
RDF Schema now defines admission and custodianship rules for the RDF and RDFS vocabulary registries. New terms must come from Recommendation-track specifications and have general RDF utility.

The responsible Working Group handles changes; if none exists, the W3C Team arranges continued custody. Definitions of rdf:HTML and rdf:XMLLiteral also move from informative to normative text.

Changes: rdf-schema commit 476ad2dc; rdf-schema commit 97352555; rdf-schema commit 83401dd5.

item.title: Turtle and TriG Reserve Version Directives for Future Syntax
item.description:
Turtle 1.2 and TriG 1.2 now require any future incompatible syntax that reuses their media types to declare a version greater than 1.2.

The rule lets older parsers recognize documents that use unsupported future features instead of misinterpreting them as current syntax.

Changes: rdf-turtle commit 438fcc69; rdf-trig commit 7994a40b.

item.title: Linked Web Storage Defines Missing-Container Creation Errors
item.description:
Linked Web Storage now gives create-resource operations an explicit Target Not Found outcome when the destination container does not exist.

The HTTP binding maps that outcome to 404 and no longer phrases the requirement as a broad “MUST return 404 unless” rule, making room for authorization and other failures to take precedence.

Changes: lws-protocol commit 181ed0dc.

item.title: Draft Intentional Friction Note Expands Its Games Analysis
item.description:
The draft Intentional Friction Note now expands its discussion of flow, neurodiversity, information discovery, and high-difficulty “soulslike” games.

It distinguishes challenge that supports a game’s purpose from barriers that merely exclude players, while continuing to flag unresolved sections and editorial work. The document remains an early draft.

Changes: intentional-friction commit 424864ea; intentional-friction commit 9e26ac6e; intentional-friction commit 3b5f82a1; intentional-friction commit 60b530c1.

item.title: WAI Pages Print the Contents of Disclosure Widgets
item.description:
W3C’s accessibility-site theme now expands details elements when printing, so content hidden behind disclosure widgets is not omitted from paper or PDF output.

The print stylesheet also removes the interactive disclosure marker, leaving a clean, complete document.

Changes: wai-website-theme commit fbcd04af.
